# `aube cat-index`

- **Usage:** `aube cat-index <PACKAGE>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Print the cached package index JSON for `<name>@<version>`

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube cat-index react@19.1.0
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package to inspect, in `name@version` form (e.g. `lodash@4.17.21`, `@babel/core@7.26.0`).

  An exact version is required — ranges and dist-tags aren't resolved here.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
